sources.note: Checked for a correction on 2026-10-15 (A1.5): Crossref returns no work registered as updating this DOI, bioRxiv has only v1 and v2 of the preprint, and the Europe PMC record is closed access with no supplementary material listed. sources.title: File listing of LongSafari/open-genome at revision main
sources.note: A listing, not a document: it records what the release exposed at the revision and date stored in the capture, and a later revision may differ. Used for a statement about which components the release exposes by path, which the card alone cannot settle. Claims from it must be dated.

sources.title: Lineage-tag sample of LongSafari/open-genome stage2/train (8 offsets, 800 rows)
sources.note: A sample, not a document, and the weakest kind of entry in this store: 800 of 2,652,947 rows, drawn as eight contiguous blocks of 100 rather than at random, so it supports qualitative statements about what the split contains and no published proportion. Stores lineage tags and counts only — no genomic sequence enters this repo. Dated, and a later revision of the dataset may differ.

sources.title: Nguyen et al. 2024 — Sequence modeling and design from molecular to genome scale (Science, version of record)
sources.blocker: science.org returns HTTP 403; Europe PMC holds the record as PMC12057570 but fullTextXML returns HTTP 500 and the article is marked not open access; the PMC article page returns HTTP 200 but serves a reCAPTCHA challenge rather than content.
sources.note: Identified while closing the A1.1 gap. The version of record may carry a fuller data availability statement than the preprint; quotes must come from S-EVO1-PREPRINT until this is retrieved. Note that one of the three attempts returned HTTP 200 without returning the document, so status here rests on the content received, not the code.

sources.title: Rives et al. 2021 — Biological structure and function emerge from scaling unsupervised learning to 250 million protein sequences (PNAS, version of record)
sources.note: The paper that defines the UR100, UR50/S and UR50/D dataset notation the ESM repository's model table uses; retrieved for A1.3 (DECISIONS.md D-025). Captured as JATS XML from the Europe PMC REST endpoint because pnas.org returns HTTP 403 and the PMC article page serves an interstitial rather than the PDF. The capture is the publisher's own full text, not a mirror's rendering, but quotes are matched against XML bytes, so a quotation must not span inline markup (an <xref> citation marker, a formula) — pick a sentence that reads clean in the source.

sources.title: Lin et al. 2022 — Evolutionary-scale prediction of atomic level protein structure with a language model (preprint)
sources.note: ESM-2's own paper, and the first-party statement of what ESM-2 was trained on. Retrieved 2026-10-14 after the earlier HTTP 429 lifted; the host rate-limits bursts rather than sustaining a block, so one request every few minutes succeeds where repeated attempts do not. NOTE ON THE CHECKSUM: biorxiv.org stamps the download time into the PDF's XMP ModifyDate and MetadataDate, so the bytes differ on every fetch and this sha256 will NOT reproduce. Verified by comparing this capture against an independently downloaded copy: 30 bytes differ, all of them in those two timestamps, and the extracted text is identical. So the hash fixes this capture, not the document.
